submittedParameters.prompt: Use case precise-object-edit. EDIT ONLY knee, ankle and boot alignment in image1, a single frame of this same mountain guardian boy running NORTHEAST AWAY from camera, back three-quarter view. Preserve its complete upper body, camera direction, proportions, hip location, same staff anatomical right hand SCREEN RIGHT, shield anatomical left arm SCREEN LEFT, costume, rendering, and transparent background. Inputs2 identity,3 committed NE idle direction,4 approved polished Q-style,5 neighboring run phase for consistent leg axis. Correct sideways hip/knee rotation rather than replacing the pose. Legs run in two close parallel fore-aft lanes pointing NORTH-EAST, never side-kick wide, frog kick or roll ankles. Bent knee, ankle center and length of the boot follow one coherent forward/back trajectory. Keep BOTH legs and both complete boots visible, with natural knee bend. No duplicated limbs, sole pasted sideways, extra feet, cropping, shadow or background; real transparent alpha. Preserve this individual frame's action, hand/weapon pose and body phase, not identical to neighbor.Frame03. Anatomical RIGHT leg SCREEN RIGHT still planted, body passes over it. Anatomical LEFT leg SCREEN LEFT airborne and flexed behind. Reduce the lateral leftward splay of left shin and shoe; tuck it into the narrow NE running lane underneath its own knee instead of kicking toward screen-left. Neighbor04 shows suitable alignment, but retain image1's distinct 03 pose. Heel, ankle and knee transition smoothly from previous phase. Do not swap support.
